run_codespell_ignore_generator: run the script to parse codespell error output and generate a .codespell-ignore-lines file
parse_codespell_errors: parse a codespell errors text file and extract unique offending source lines
extract_source_lines: extract source code lines from codespell error output using filename and line number
cache_file_contents: cache file contents in memory to avoid repeated disk reads when processing multiple errors
deduplicate_suppressions: deduplicate extracted source lines so each unique line is printed only once
